summary: SOBR Safe filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 17, 2026, it, CWV, Merger Sub and principal Roy DiBenerdini executed a Mutual Termination Agreement ending their April 24, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization. The parties mutually released claims tied to the merger and ancillary documents, except breaches of the Termination Agreement or the April 6, 2026 NDA, which survives. SOBR will withdraw its Form S-4 registration statement filed June 9, 2026. No price, premium, break fee or closing date was stated; watch for strategic alternatives and residual costs.
